hypothesis: With a fixed 120-row V3 TRAIN budget, Spanish contextual embeddings plus a supervised head may behave differently from lexical TF-IDF on new semantic families. This tests representation, not synthetic volume or human generalization.
pooling: attention-mask mean excluding padding; includes special tokens; per-row L2

baselines.svm_calibration: sigmoid on TRAIN-only 3-fold StratifiedGroupKFold, entire TF-IDF inside folds

partial_finetune.initialization: selected frozen supervised head, original encoder
partial_finetune.dropout_encoder: encoder.eval() for deterministic bounded technical probe; gradients still enabled on layer11

selection: development Macro-F1; ties lower development cross-entropy then earliest candidate; never assessment
assessment: one pass per selected estimator, after selection.json is saved; saved predictions used for all slices and error analysis
review_policy: existing DEMO rules described only, no new threshold or calibration selection, not validated for contextual models
limits: Single training seed and small assistant-authored evaluation; no population claim.
New assessment becomes observed evidence after first run, never a fresh final test for later choices.
No corpus generation or revision in response to evaluation scores.
No actual human sentiment corpus or real voice supplied.
